findings.claim: The change removes the Str8 branch from the string header writer in MessagePackPrimitives.Writers.cs. Strings of 32 to 255 bytes will then be written with Str16 instead of the compact Str8, which changes the wire format and bloats output. This is unrelated to the analyzer bug in REQ-2234, which requires that behaviour with SuppressSourceGeneration unset or false does not change. It also breaks MessagePack spec canonical encoding, and tests that assert exact bytes will likely fail.

receipt_plan.detail: Serialize a 100-byte ASCII string with base-built and head-built MessagePack. Base emits 0xD9 0x64 + data, head emits 0xDA 0x00 0x64 + data. Also run the existing string-header and primitive writer tests.

findings.claim: The README says the analyzer does not report MsgPack011, MsgPack016 or MsgPack017 for suppressed types, and a test asserts this. This matches ledger entry L19, which records it as deliberate and not a defect, even though 3.1.0 reported them. Checked and fine.

receipt_plan.detail: [L19] Generation-only diagnostics (MsgPack011, MsgPack016, MsgPack017) are deliberately not reported for SuppressSourceGeneration = true types.
